environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in us-east-1, public subnet with IGW route, Security Group sg-0x4a2b allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF. Service is directly internet-facing via Elastic IP 54.x.x.x. Container runs as root with default network namespace.
